panels.scene: SAM at his desk with the phone to his ear, frowning, a pen in hand over a notepad whose page is covered only in plain wavy lines and crossed-out squiggles, no letters or words anywhere. The green kettle on a shelf.
dialogue: Okay, and how is the letter, the pills, the gutters...
panels.caption: The call turned into a list.

panels.scene: JUNE in the garden in gloves, phone held away from her ear, amused, a watering can beside her.
SAM laughing quietly at his desk, phone in hand, mug nearby, the pen put down. No notepad on the desk. The green kettle on a shelf.
panels.caption: Better call.
